Package com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository

Class EntrantRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository.EntrantRepository
public class EntrantRepository extends Object
Handles all Firestore operations for entrant subcollections stored at events/{eventId}/entrants/{deviceId}. Manages waitlist membership, status transitions, and history queries.

  • Method Details

    • joinWaitlist

      public void joinWaitlist(String eventId, String deviceId, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<Void> callback)
      Adds a user to an event's waitlist. Creates the entrant doc at events/{eventId}/entrants/{deviceId} with status Entrant.STATUS_WAITLIST.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event to join
      deviceId - the device ID of the user joining
      callback - receives null on success

    • updateStatus

      public void updateStatus(String eventId, String deviceId, String newStatus, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<Void> callback)
      Updates an entrant's status (e.g. waitlist → invited, invited → enrolled). Also updates the statusUpdatedAt timestamp to now.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event
      deviceId - the device ID of the entrant
      newStatus - the new status value (use Entrant STATUS_* constants)
      callback - receives null on success

    • getEntrantsByStatus

      public void getEntrantsByStatus(String eventId, String status, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<List<Entrant>> callback)
      Returns all entrants for an event with a specific status. e.g. getEntrantsByStatus(eventId, Entrant.STATUS_WAITLIST, callback)
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event
      status - the status to filter by (use Entrant STATUS_* constants)
      callback - receives the list of matching Entrant objects on success

    • getAllEntrantsForEvent

      public void getAllEntrantsForEvent(String eventId, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<List<Entrant>> callback)
      Returns all entrant docs for an event regardless of status. Useful for showing the full entrant list grouped by status.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event
      callback - receives the list of all Entrant objects on success

    • getUserEventHistory

      public void getUserEventHistory(String deviceId, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<List<Entrant>> callback)
      Returns the full event history for a user across ALL events. Uses a Firestore collection group query on all "entrants" subcollections.

      NOTE: This requires a Firestore composite index. When you first run this, Firestore will log a link in Logcat — click it to auto-create the index. Or go to Firebase Console → Firestore → Indexes → Add: Collection group: entrants | Field: deviceId ASC

      Parameters:
      deviceId - the device ID of the user whose history to fetch
      callback - receives the list of Entrant objects (with eventId populated) on success

    • getEntrant

      public void getEntrant(String eventId, String deviceId, EntrantRepository.FirestoreCallback<Entrant> callback)
      Fetches a single entrant record for a user in a specific event, regardless of status. Useful for checking whether a user has already joined an event's waitlist.
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event to look up
      deviceId - the device ID of the user to check
      callback - receives the Entrant if the user is an entrant, or null if not found
